issue.body:
It would be nice to be able to pass an awaitable instead of a function to `BackgroundTask`. If your code is already async, it would make the API less awkward:

```python

async def some_background_job(foo, bar):
    ...

# current - no autocomplete in IDE
BackgroundTask(some_background_job, 1, 5)

#proposed - autocomplete working as expected
BackgroundTask(some_background_job(1, 5))
```
issue.title: Allow passing an awaitable as a background task
